_comment: One virtual fence per camera, in pixels of the full frame (1920 wide; G639 is portrait 1072x1920). Each line was drawn across the busiest annotated walkway or road seen in the ground-truth ground-point paths of that camera's selected clips plus one frame, BEFORE any pipeline result was looked at. direction=both. Not calibrated: MEVA cameras have no homography for the service's metre-based rules.
